AI Search Optimisation (GEO) in Coimbatore: packages and prices

Get your business understood, cited and recommended in AI answers and AI search results.

Quick answer

AI Search Optimisation (GEO) from Vintorex Digital Solutions in Coimbatore starts at ₹19,999 per month for the Starter package and goes up to ₹74,999 per month for Premium, excluding 18% GST. Typical market prices run ₹50,000 to ₹3,50,000 per month. Delivery: baseline in 2 weeks.

Overview

More people ask AI assistants and AI search features instead of clicking ten links. We check how those answers describe your business, fix the gaps in your entity data, schema and content, and build the mentions that make assistants confident enough to recommend you. We report what we can measure honestly.

Ideal for

  • Businesses whose customers research with AI assistants
  • Brands that are missing or misdescribed in AI answers
  • Companies already doing SEO that want to protect visibility
